conventions.convention: Arnoldi restart uses exact arithmetic, 1 ≤ r < m ≤ n, normalized projected eigenvectors, independent residual-accepted locked directions, and a supplied finite-return projected eigensolver whose complete eigenvalue list is validated including algebraic multiplicities.
Implicit QR uses ordered top-down adjacent-row Givens eliminations, p = m − r shifts, Q = Q₁⋯Qₚ, and q(z) = ∏(z − μⱼ).

LOBPCG assumes complex Hermitian A, Hermitian positive-definite B and fixed T, a B-orthonormal initial block, exact rank compression, and selection of the q smallest projected eigenvalues. Residual acceptance uses Euclidean column norms.
Generalized eigenvalues and Ritz values are ordered increasingly, with multiplicity; trial bases are B-orthonormal.
The angle enclosure assumes 1 ≤ q < n and λq < λq+1; sin ϑ is the supremum of the B-norm of the complementary spectral projection over B-unit trial vectors.
Shift-invert requires M = A − σI invertible. Harmonic extraction instead checks the rank of MU and reports values of the computed perturbed projected pencil with its QZ ledger.
Solve residuals have sign s₀ = My − u, transformed residuals are rT = y − θu, and finite inverse mapping requires θ ≠ 0.

load_bearing.statement: For 1 ≤ j ≤ dim S, λj ≤ θj(S). If S ⊆ T and j ≤ dim S, then θj(T) ≤ θj(S), for Hermitian A and positive-definite Hermitian B with B-orthonormal trial bases.

Defines finite-budget exact thick and implicit Arnoldi restarts, validated supplied projected eigensolves, independent residual-based locking, explicit failure statuses, and a thick fallback when implicit mode has locked pairs.

Defines block LOBPCG for Hermitian A and positive-definite Hermitian B,T, retaining the old block in the exact rank-compressed trial span and selecting its q smallest Ritz values within a finite update budget.

Under the stated no-breakdown, ordered-Givens, nonannihilation, filtered-dimension and nonzero-ρ hypotheses, range(Vm Q(:,1:r)) = Kr(A,q(A)v₁), and the retained basis satisfies AVr+ = Vr+ Hr+ + g er*, with g orthogonal to the retained columns.
Defines shift-invert candidate extraction with original residual checks and solve-error records, and harmonic extraction with rank checking, a finite-budget QZ call, and explicit status mappings.
For invertible M = A − σI, eigenvalues map by θ = (λ − σ)⁻¹. For nonzero u and θ, s₀ = My − u and rT = y − θu imply (A − λI)u = θ⁻¹(s₀ − MrT), where λ = σ + 1/θ.

concerns.concern: The Statement assumes “ρ ≠ 0 in the factorization q(H_m)=QR with R upper triangular” without defining ρ. Proof 2.1 supplies the intended meaning through “Re₁ = ρe₁”. Define ρ = R₁₁ in the Statement; the argument itself establishes the required interpretation.

seams_checked.note: Contextual seam: no direct Schur-item invocation occurs in the assigned proofs. The page preserves the supplier's separation of residual/backward information from nonnormal forward accuracy and makes no unconditional shift-convergence claim.

Contextual seam: the assigned restart analysis uses exact arithmetic and does not import finite-precision orthogonality bounds or a Lanczos convergence rate. Its bad-shift example is consistent with the supplier's dependence on spectral separation and starting components.

Opened the B-metric definition, Hermitian-definite spectral theorem, regular-pencil definition, QZ algorithm, and QZ termination/equivalence proposition. The consumers preserve positive definiteness, exclude rank-deficient harmonic pencils before QZ, map all QZ statuses, and identify reported harmonic values with the perturbed computed pencil.

Contextual seam: LOBPCG explicitly assumes a fixed Hermitian positive-definite T and does not infer that property from ILU(0) or flexible GMRES. No unsupported preconditioner-quality or residual-metric claim crosses the seam.

Opened the Gaussian-quadrature page and Golub–Welsch algorithm. Its m ≥ 2 proposal call uses full dimension m, target m−1, a finite restart budget, an explicit target rule, and the supplier's projected-solver contract. Failure statuses become inconclusive; Ritz data remain proposals subject to independent interval certification.
